title.english: A Basket Is Not a Cart

pairs.target: nài lěi cóng bái lì dào huílái nàtiān , tǎ wéi shì zài xǐ wù jiān zhǎodào tā de .
pairs.english: On the day Nerai returned from White Shingle Track, Tavi found her in the washroom.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾从白砾道回来那天，塔维是在洗物间找到她的。

pairs.target: lí liànxí kè yǐjīng guò le liùtiān . tā àn yuándìng de rìzi chūfā , zài nàbiān zhù le sìyè .
pairs.english: Six days had passed since practice. She had left on the appointed day and spent four nights there.
pairs.hanzi: 离练习课已经过了六天。她按原定的日子出发，在那边住了四夜。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běnlái zhī xiǎng bǎ jièlái de zhíchǐ hái qù , què tīngjiàn yuànlǐ yǒurén hǎn tā , shēngyīn hěn xiǎng , shuō lánzi bùnéng suàn chē .
pairs.english: Tavi had only intended to return a borrowed ruler, but heard someone calling to her in the yard, loudly insisting that baskets were not carts.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本来只想把借来的直尺还去，却听见院里有人喊她，声音很响，说篮子不能算车。

pairs.target: xǐ wù jiān ménkǒu zhàn zhe gè huī biànzi de nǚrén , jiǎo biān liǎnggè biǎn lán tào zài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: A woman with a grey braid stood at the washroom door, two flat baskets nested at her feet.
pairs.hanzi: 洗物间门口站着个灰辫子的女人，脚边两个扁篮套在一起。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhèngzài shuā cè jù xiāngdǐ de ní , tīng wán táiqǐ tóu . "
pairs.english: Nerai was scrubbing mud from the bottom of an instrument case. She looked up.
pairs.hanzi:
奈蕾正在刷测具箱底的泥，听完抬起头。
“

pairs.target: wǒ méi shuō lánzi shì chē . " "
pairs.english: “I didn't say a basket was a cart.”
pairs.hanzi:
我没说篮子是车。”
“

pairs.target: nà nǐ bǎ ' bùnéng yùnhuò ' xiě zài nàlǐ , ménkǒu de rén zěnme tīng ? "
pairs.english: “Then how are the people at the gate meant to read ‘no goods transport’ when you write it there?”
pairs.hanzi: 那你把‘不能运货’写在那里，门口的人怎么听？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tíng zài ménbiān . nài lěi kànjiàn tā , jiāng shī shuāzi gēxià , jièshào shuō zhèwèi jì shěn
pairs.english: Tavi stopped at the door. Seeing him, Nerai set down the wet brush and introduced Auntie Ji,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维停在门边。奈蕾看见他，将湿刷子搁下，介绍说这位蓟婶

pairs.target: zhù zài bái lì dào , shì zhècì dài tāmen zǒu ràoxíng lù de rén .
pairs.english: Who lived at White Shingle Track and had led them along the detour.
pairs.hanzi: 住在白砾道，是这次带他们走绕行路的人。

pairs.target: jì shěn dǎliang le tǎ wéi yìyǎn , wèn tā néng bunéng bāngmáng bǎ xiàmiàn nà zhī lánzi chōuchūlái .
pairs.english: Ji looked Tavi over and asked whether he could help separate the bottom basket.
pairs.hanzi: 蓟婶打量了塔维一眼，问他能不能帮忙把下面那只篮子抽出来。

pairs.target: liǎngzhī lán yán kǎ dé hěn jǐn . tǎ wéi dūnxiàlái , ànzhù wàimiàn nà zhī , jì shěn bān le bān lǐmiàn de biān , zhōngyú fēnkāi .
pairs.english: The rims were tightly stuck. Tavi crouched and held the outer one while Ji flexed the inner rim until they came apart.
pairs.hanzi: 两只篮沿卡得很紧。塔维蹲下来，按住外面那只，蓟婶扳了扳里面的边，终于分开。

pairs.target: tā bǎ yìzhī héng fàngzài dèng shàng , lìngyìzhī shù zài pángbiān . "
pairs.english: She laid one across a stool and stood the other beside it.
pairs.hanzi:
她把一只横放在凳上，另一只竖在旁边。
“

pairs.target: wǒ liǎngzhī shǒutí guòqù . háishì bèi zài bèishàng guòqù . nǐmen dé shuō qīngchǔ . "
pairs.english: “I carry them through in my hands. Or on my back. You need to make it clear.”
pairs.hanzi: 我两只手提过去。还是背在背上过去。你们得说清楚。”

pairs.target: nài lěi cāgān shǒu , cóng xiāng dài lǐ qǔchū huílái qián huà de cǎotú .
pairs.english: Nerai dried her hands and took a sketch made before her return from the case pocket.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾擦干手，从箱袋里取出回来前画的草图。

pairs.target: tā méi ràng tǎ wéi huíbì , jiào tā bǎ dèngzǐ shàng de kōng bùdài nuókāi , pùzhǐ .
pairs.english: She did not ask Tavi to leave, but told him to move an empty cloth bag off a stool and spread out the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 她没让塔维回避，叫他把凳子上的空布袋挪开，铺纸。

pairs.target: xīnlù méiyǒu zǒu jiù zhījià shàngmiàn .
pairs.english: The new path did not run over the old supports.
pairs.hanzi: 新路没有走旧支架上面。

pairs.target: jì shěn dài rén kàn de kàoshān zhǎidào , xiàmiàn réng yǒu yíduàn dā zài jiù gòujiàn shàng .
pairs.english: Part of the narrow mountainside path Ji had shown them still rested on old components.
pairs.hanzi: 蓟婶带人看的靠山窄道，下面仍有一段搭在旧构件上。

pairs.target: chá zhījià de rén qiāokāi pángbiān de bǔ shí , cái kànqīng tā hé xiàfāng de héng tiě bìng méiyǒu wánquán fēnkāi .
pairs.english: The support examiner had opened the stone patch beside it and found it was not fully separate from the iron crosspiece below.
pairs.hanzi: 查支架的人敲开旁边的补石，才看清它和下方的横铁并没有完全分开。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō , zhè yíduàn bùnéng zhào zhùhù yuánxiān xiǎng de nàyàng , sǎo gānjìng jiù fàng rén zǒu .
pairs.english: Nerai said they could not simply sweep that stretch clean and let people through as the residents had hoped.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说，这一段不能照住户原先想的那样，扫干净就放人走。

pairs.target: jì shěn shēnshǒu zhǐ dào tú de lìngyìbiān . " hòulái wǒmen zǒu zhèlǐ . "
pairs.english: Ji pointed to the other side of the sketch. “Then we went here.”
pairs.hanzi:
蓟婶伸手指到图的另一边。
“后来我们走这里。”

pairs.target: nà shì yídào jiù shíjiē , chuānguò liǎnghù rénjiā hòumiàn de shàichǎng .
pairs.english: An old stone stair passed through drying yards behind two homes.
pairs.hanzi: 那是一道旧石阶，穿过两户人家后面的晒场。

pairs.target: pō bǐ yuánlái nàtiáo ràoxíng lù duǎn , shíjiē zhíjiē zuòzài yán miànshàng .
pairs.english: The slope was shorter than the old detour, and the steps sat directly on bedrock.
pairs.hanzi: 坡比原来那条绕行路短，石阶直接坐在岩面上。

pairs.target: tóngháng de rén chá guò liǎngcè hé xiàmiàn , néng quèdìng bú jiè nàduàn jiù zhījià chéngzhòng .
pairs.english: Her companions had checked both sides and underneath, confirming it carried no weight on those old supports.
pairs.hanzi: 同行的人查过两侧和下面，能确定不借那段旧支架承重。

pairs.target: zhùhù dāying báitiān ràng rén tōngguò , shíjiē wàicè quē de lángān , yě yǐjīng ràng mùjiàng zhàozhe liáng hǎo de wèizhì bǔ shàng . "
pairs.english: The householders agreed to daytime passage; a carpenter had fitted the missing outer railing at the measured positions.
pairs.hanzi:
住户答应白天让人通过，石阶外侧缺的栏杆，也已经让木匠照着量好的位置补上。
“

pairs.target: lángān zhuāng hǎo le ? " tǎ wéi wèn . " zuótiānxiàwǔ . " jì shěn shuō , "
pairs.english: “The railing's finished?” Tavi asked. “Yesterday afternoon,” Ji said.
pairs.hanzi:
栏杆装好了？”塔维问。
“昨天下午。”蓟婶说，“

pairs.target: jīntiān zǎoshàng wǒmen zìjǐ zǒu guòlái de . hái méi zhèngshì kāi , nǐmen de rén ràng wǒmen gēnzhe yàn wán zài zǒu . "
pairs.english: “We walked over it this morning. It isn't officially open yet; your people let us follow them once the inspection was done.”
pairs.hanzi: 今天早上我们自己走过来的。还没正式开，你们的人让我们跟着验完再走。”

pairs.target: tā búshì lái tǎo yìtiáo shàngwèi cúnzài de lù . lù yǐjīng zài nàlǐ , zhèng děng zhe huànxià lùkǒu de páizi .
pairs.english: She had not come to beg for a path that did not yet exist. It was already there, waiting for the sign at its entrance to be changed.
pairs.hanzi: 她不是来讨一条尚未存在的路。路已经在那里，正等着换下路口的牌子。

pairs.target: cǎotú shàng xiě zhe zhī zhǔn xíngrén , bùzhǔn chēliàng . xiàmiàn lìng tiān le yìháng , bùdé yùnhuò .
pairs.english: The sketch said pedestrians only, no vehicles. Another line below said no goods transport.
pairs.hanzi: 草图上写着只准行人，不准车辆。下面另添了一行，不得运货。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái míngbái jì shěn wèishénme bǎ lánzi dàilái . "
pairs.english: Now Tavi understood why Ji had brought her baskets.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维这才明白蓟婶为什么把篮子带来。
“

pairs.target: chēngzhòng gěi shuí kàn ? " tā wèn , " sòng nǎi de , mǎi mǐ de , nándào dōu dékòng zhuóshǒu ?
pairs.english: “Who are we weighing things for?” she asked. “Milk deliveries, rice buyers—must everyone come empty-handed?
pairs.hanzi: 称重给谁看？”她问，“送奶的，买米的，难道都得空着手？

pairs.target: jiào rén bānjiā yě bùnéng yítàng zhī ná gè zhěntou . "
pairs.english: You can't make someone moving house carry just a pillow each trip.”
pairs.hanzi: 叫人搬家也不能一趟只拿个枕头。”

pairs.target: nài lěi chéngrèn nàjùhuà tài kuān .
pairs.english: Nerai admitted the wording was too broad.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾承认那句话太宽。

pairs.target: xiànzhì chēliàng , shìyīnwèi zhǎi táijiē hé zhuǎnwān ; shǒutí bēifù yào kàn fùhé shí dìngxià de tōngxíng yāoqiú ,
pairs.english: Vehicles were restricted because of narrow steps and bends; hand-carried and back-carried loads needed to follow the inspection's passage rules,
pairs.hanzi: 限制车辆，是因为窄台阶和转弯；手提背负要看复核时定下的通行要求，

pairs.target: bùnéng yòng yíjù jìn huò shěngdiào .
pairs.english: They could not be replaced with a blanket ban on goods.
pairs.hanzi: 不能用一句禁货省掉。

pairs.target: tā fān chū lìng yìzhāng yàn lù de jìlù , zhǎodào liǎnggè rén cuò shēn de wèizhì , háiyǒu guǎijiǎo bùnéng tíngliú duī wù de shuōmíng .
pairs.english: She found another inspection record, locating the passing places and the instruction not to stop or pile things at the bend.
pairs.hanzi: 她翻出另一张验路的记录，找到两个人错身的位置，还有拐角不能停留堆物的说明。

pairs.target: jì shěn bǎ zìjǐ de lánzi fàngzài liǎngzhāng dèngzǐ zhōngjiān , héng zhe shì le yíbiàn , pèngdào le dèng jiǎo .
pairs.english: Ji put her baskets between two stools and tried them sideways; they caught on the legs.
pairs.hanzi: 蓟婶把自己的篮子放在两张凳子中间，横着试了一遍，碰到了凳脚。

pairs.target: huànchéng yìqiányīhòu , jiù guòqù le . "
pairs.english: With one in front and one behind, they went through.
pairs.hanzi:
换成一前一后，就过去了。
“

alignment.english: one in front and one behind

pairs.target: wǒ de jiùshì zhème tí . " " lù bǐ zhè hái zhǎi xiē . " nài lěi shuō . "
pairs.english: “That's how I carry them.” “The path is narrower than this,” Nerai said.
pairs.hanzi:
我的就是这么提。”
“路比这还窄些。”奈蕾说。
“

pairs.target: suǒyǐ wǒ ràng nǐ xiě , búshì ràng tā xiànzài diǎntóu . "
pairs.english: “Which is why I'm asking you to write it down, not asking him to approve it right now.”
pairs.hanzi: 所以我让你写，不是让他现在点头。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèng xiǎng shuō néng guò , huà yìngshēngshēng tíngzhù le .
pairs.english: Tavi had been about to say they could pass. The words stopped dead.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维正想说能过，话硬生生停住了。

pairs.target: nài lěi jiāngyào gǎi de jùzi lìng xiě zài zhǐ shàng , yòu zhùmíng xū yóu yàn lù de tóngbàn hézhǔn , wǔhòu dài qù lùkǒu huàn pái .
pairs.english: Nerai wrote the proposed change on a separate sheet, noting that her fellow inspector must approve it, and that it would be taken to the entrance that afternoon to replace the sign.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾将要改的句子另写在纸上，又注明须由验路的同伴核准，午后带去路口换牌。

pairs.target: jì shěn shuō zìjǐ bù huíqù děng , yào gēnzhe qù .
pairs.english: Ji said she would not go home to wait; she would go with her.
pairs.hanzi: 蓟婶说自己不回去等，要跟着去。

pairs.target: nài lěi dāying le , jiāng zhǐ yā zài zhíchǐ xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: Nerai agreed and weighed the paper down with the ruler.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾答应了，将纸压在直尺下面。

pairs.target: jiù chēdào háishì fēng zhe .
pairs.english: The old cart road remained closed.
pairs.hanzi: 旧车道还是封着。

pairs.target: jì shěn tídào gébì yùn tàn de rén , shuō shǎo pá yíduàn pō dāngrán hǎo , kě tàn búhuì yīncǐ zìjǐ cháng tuǐ .
pairs.english: Ji mentioned her coal-hauling neighbour: climbing less of the slope was good, of course, but it would not make coal grow legs.
pairs.hanzi: 蓟婶提到隔壁运炭的人，说少爬一段坡当然好，可炭不会因此自己长腿。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán biàn shōuqǐ lánzi , méiyǒu děng shuí tì yùn tàn de rén zuò bǎozhèng .
pairs.english: She put away her baskets without waiting for anyone to make promises on his behalf.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完便收起篮子，没有等谁替运炭的人作保证。

pairs.target: nài lěi ná qǐ shuāzi , shǒu tíng le hěn jiǔ , cái jìxù xǐ xiāngdǐ .
pairs.english: Nerai picked up the brush. Her hand paused for a long time before she resumed washing the case's bottom.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾拿起刷子，手停了很久，才继续洗箱底。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūnxiàlái tì tā fúzhù xiāng jiǎo . níshuǐ shùnzhe qiǎngōu liúzǒu , xiāngdǐ lùchū jǐdào jiù huàhén .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched to hold the case corner for her. Muddy water ran along a shallow channel, revealing old scratches underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲下来替她扶住箱角。泥水顺着浅沟流走，箱底露出几道旧划痕。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng wèn zǒu nàtiáo ràolù lèibulèi , juéde zhèhuà tài qīng , biàn méiyǒu wèn . "
pairs.english: He wanted to ask if walking the detour had been tiring, but it seemed too slight a question, so he did not ask.
pairs.hanzi:
他想问走那条绕路累不累，觉得这话太轻，便没有问。
“

pairs.target: tā yílù zǒu dé bǐ wǒ kuài . " nài lěi hūrán shuō , " bèizhe dōngxī .
pairs.english: “She walked faster than me the whole way,” Nerai suddenly said. “Carrying things.
pairs.hanzi: 她一路走得比我快。”奈蕾忽然说，“背着东西。

pairs.target: dào le shàngmiàn , zuò le hǎo yíhuìer cái kěn zhàn qǐlái . "
pairs.english: When we reached the top, she sat a long time before she would get up.”
pairs.hanzi: 到了上面，坐了好一会儿才肯站起来。”

pairs.target: wàitou jì shěn jiào tāmen , wèn fùjìn yǒuméiyǒu mài rètāng de , tā dài de bǐng liáng le .
pairs.english: Outside, Ji called to ask whether anyone nearby sold hot soup; her flatbread had gone cold.
pairs.hanzi: 外头蓟婶叫他们，问附近有没有卖热汤的，她带的饼凉了。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ shuāzi sāi gěi tǎ wéi , chūqù zhǐlù .
pairs.english: Nerai handed Tavi the brush and went out to give directions.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把刷子塞给塔维，出去指路。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng zuìhòu yìdiǎn ní xǐdiào , līn qǐ xiāngzǐ liàng zài ménbiān .
pairs.english: Tavi washed away the last mud and set the case by the door to dry.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将最后一点泥洗掉，拎起箱子晾在门边。

pairs.target: zhíchǐ hái yā zhe nà zhāng zhǐ , tā juédìng chīwánfàn zài lái ná .
pairs.english: The ruler still held down the paper. He decided to collect it after lunch.
pairs.hanzi: 直尺还压着那张纸，他决定吃完饭再来拿。
